title: Docs contain session scaffolding (ChatGPT test prompt, TI end-to-end check)
description:
**Problem**
Two public docs in the Papyrus repo are session scaffolding rather than documentation: a prompt to paste into ChatGPT with a gate on an assistant ("Do not post until Claude confirms ..."), and a one-off end-to-end check for a specific Threat Intelligence deploy.

**Evidence**
- docs/cyclotron-chatgpt-test-prompt.md:3: "Do not post until Claude confirms the Threat Intelligence deploy and the end-to-end check."
- docs/cyclotron-ti-end-to-end-check.md: a one-time checklist tied to that deploy.

**Fix**
Delete both files, or move any durable content into a normal runbook with neutral wording. Move the one-off check to a Kanbus issue.

**How to verify**
`ls docs/cyclotron-chatgpt-test-prompt.md docs/cyclotron-ti-end-to-end-check.md` reports both missing, and `grep -rn 'Claude confirms' docs` returns nothing.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
